Frontend at 390px as sidoarjo@pgs.id. (1) pe-publish-new from a draft (?draft=): the product is published and the draft deleted. The URL becomes /product-editor/new and the title shows 'Tambah Produk'. The name, description, price and photos are cleared, while category Dapur, subcategory Peralatan Masak and etalase 'TEST Etalase' are kept. pe-toast-ok shows the success message. The drafts banner refreshes and shows only the remaining draft, and tapping its chip loads that draft. The product is updated (same product_id, name changed in the DB). Then the URL becomes /product-editor/new with 'Tambah Produk' and the 'Publikasikan' button, pe-delete is hidden, category, subcategory and etalase are kept, the toast shows and the drafts banner appears. The next publish creates the new product sp_95724c4d47 and the success dialog shows. (3) The pe-kw-del box is 32x36, about 48x52 with hitSlop 8, and a tap at its edge removes the chip. Title idea 3 is now 'TEST_Cetakan Kue Suggo Tujuh Lubang Aluminium Murah Siap Kirim' (62 characters): the ' - PGS Sidoarjo' suffix is dropped and nothing is cut with '…'. Idea 1 keeps '| PGS Sidoarjo' because it fits (68). (4) Preview: picking Biru shows Rp25.000. After closing and reopening, it shows 'Mulai Rp15.000' with no chip selected. All TEST_ products and drafts were cleaned up by id.
critical_code_review_comments: [id].tsx:120 uses a skipReload ref together with router.setParams({id:'new', draft: undefined}). This works because the effect re-runs exactly once per param change. It would break if a future change made the effect run twice (for example, React StrictMode in dev on native). Consider resetting skipReload in a cleanup step or comparing it to the target params.

product-preview.tsx:17 resets picked/img in a useEffect, so the first frame after opening can still show the old selection before the reset. This was not visible in testing. Resetting in onClose would avoid it.

rca_of_issue: The iter25 bug is fixed. publish() now always resets in place with loaded(next) and, when the editor was opened from a draft or a product, sets skipReload and calls router.setParams({id:'new', draft:undefined}). The load effect therefore no longer overwrites the prepared form, and the toast state is kept.
